text:
nina: hi team, contractor here starting today. I have Vault logins but when I try `vault kv get secret/data/apps/analytics/test-payload` I get permission denied. I need to decrypt a KMS-wrapped sample locally to validate processing. Who do I ask and what's the safe process?

leo: welcome @nina :wave: Contractors have a slightly stricter flow for KMS unwraps. For KV reads we can usually grant short-lived read access, but KMS unwrap (decrypt) needs an approval chain (app owner + security lead) and extra audit fields.

nina: ok—what's the quickest path? I'm trying to run end-to-end tests against a small dataset. Would a 72h TTL work?

infra-bot: Reminder: For any KMS unwrap requests include `business-justification`, `expiry`, `auditor` and `local-dev-hosts` in your infra-ticket. See https://confluence.redwood/security/kms-onboard.

oncall-db: @nina ping me in the ticket once filed. Typical process: 1) open infra-requests:secrets 2) set env=staging app=analytics role=read 3) set action=unwrap if you need KMS decrypt 4) ttl=72h and reason. For contractors also include the SOW/contractor-id.

nina: thanks. Any sample ticket body I can copy/paste?

leo: use this snippet in the ticket body: 
```
env: staging
app: analytics
action: unwrap
key: projects/redwood/keys/analytics-hsm
role: read
ttl: 72h
reason: onboarding contractor (nina) - local e2e test
contractor_id: CNTR-8811
approvers: @oncall-db @sec-lead
audit_comment: "temporary unwrap for test validation; no production data"
local_dev_hosts: ["192.0.2.12"]
```
Include the contract reference and approvers. Security will attach an auditor and enable a one-time unwrap token.

sec-lead: Quick policy note: we do not grant primary HSM key export or long-lived unwraps to contractors. We can mint a wrapping key in Vault that allows a single unwrap for a bounded TTL and we log the operation. Please also provide the hostname you'll run the unwrap from and confirm disk encryption on your laptop.

maria: FYI, if you only need the plaintext shape for tests, we can provide a sanitized sample instead of granting unwrap permissions. That avoids extra approval steps. Happy to create one if you want.

nina: sanitized sample sounds perfect if it's similar shape. Could you attach it to the ticket and mark it "for onboarding"?

maria: will do. If you still need the real unwrap after trying the sample, file the ticket with the snippet and CC me so I can expedite approval.

infra-bot: Ticket template: `/jira create infra-requests:secrets --body "<use snippet here>" --labels onboarding,contractor`

nina: filing now. Thanks everyone, I'll try the sample first and only request unwrap if absolutely necessary. Appreciate the quick answers!

oncall-db: When you file, add `approvers=@oncall-db @sec-lead` and I'll acknowledge. Estimated manual approval for contractor unwraps is ~1 business day.

leo: quick tip: if you hit `permission denied` with `vault kv get` run `vault token lookup` to confirm your token policies and paste the output (redact token id) into the ticket so infra can triage faster.

nina: noted — filing ticket: infra-requests:secrets title "Contractor onboarding: analytics unwrap request (nina)". I'll attach the contract id and request the sanitized sample first.

infra-bot: Created ticket IR-7721. Assigned to infra-secrets. ETA review 8 business hours.

nina: awesome, thanks all :pray:
